title: 购物推理基准：专家构建的多轮对话购物助手评测集
summary: 提出Shopping Reasoning Bench，一个由零售专家构建的基准测试，包含525个任务和10863个加权二元评分标准，覆盖五类推理和十五个子类别。评估GPT、Claude、Gemini等9个模型，总体通过率仅57-77%，多轮任务表现更差，揭示了当前模型在专家级购物建议方面的不足。
summary_en: Introduces Shopping Reasoning Bench, an expert-authored benchmark of 525 missions with 10,863 weighted binary rubrics across five reasoning categories. Evaluation of nine models shows pass rates of only 57-77%, with multi-turn performance degrading 4-18 points, highlighting gaps in expert-level shopping assistance.
